mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger is met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp in one month) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE trigger is met but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by > 10% y-o-y while the fed funds rate is above 4%, it signals a demand slowdown that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger conditions are met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening of the yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending monetary tightening that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 10y-2y spread flattens by > 50bps in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, with the 2-year Treasury yield exceeding the 10-year yield by > 50bps, signals a high likelihood of recession that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Inversion trigger is met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by > 0.3pp over 3 months while payroll employment (PAYEMS) is declining, it signals a weakening labor market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS declining
failure_condition: Trigger conditions are met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows by > 3% y-o-y while the ISM manufacturing PMI is above 60, it signals a supply-constrained overheating economy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger conditions are met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.
